source_id_namespace: Contract-local coverage IDs NH01-NH07; original source IDs remain unchanged.

data_count_routing.routing_rule: Only a successfully resolved zero count enters the separate Empty Home page.
NH02 single-catch, one centered Hero and no Pager neighbor/hint.
NH01 multiple-catch Normal Home with manual Pager.

states.condition: A successful archive resolution returns zero valid FishRecords.
states.layout: Empty Home V2.2 sibling page; use its safe-top Header, aspect-locked Hero and safe-bottom CTA group. Do not apply Normal Home layout transforms.
states.interaction: Capture enters the existing recognition flow; album/gallery action follows its registered Empty Home behavior. No record detail exists.
states.animation: Inherit exact Empty Home V2.2 motion contract; see Motion Contract.
states.accessibility: Empty Home TalkBack sequence and 48dp targets; decorative environment is not focusable.

states.condition: Initial Normal Home archive has no successfully resolved snapshot.
states.layout: Keep shared background, Header and Capture; statistics show unresolved dashes and the registered quiet Hero placeholder. Do not show Empty Home or fake zeros.
states.interaction: Capture remains available. No placeholder Hero is routed to detail.
states.animation: No loading shimmer, count-up, page-wide entrance or decorative Normal Home loop.
states.accessibility: Announce unresolved status without claiming zero records; placeholder is not a fish image.

states.condition: Resolved valid FishRecord count equals one.
states.layout: NH02 one centered full-size Hero; keep NH01 Normal Home Header/stat/CTA geometry. No adjacent fake card, Pager hint or first-catch reward layer.
states.interaction: Hero opens FishRecordDetail by stable record ID; Capture enters existing recognition flow; stats and All use their registered routes.
states.animation: Existing Hero idle and shared Capture motion only; the one-shot card entry is limited to first resolution without a retained snapshot.
states.accessibility: Hero content follows species→measurements→time/location; all controls at least 48dp; record-days is read-only.

states.condition: Resolved valid FishRecord count is at least two.
states.layout: Canonical Normal Home main image with selected Hero and source-authorized neighbor peeks; one shared responsive transform for all core regions.
states.interaction: User-driven horizontal Pager only; keep selected stable record ID through reorder/refresh; no automatic advance.
states.animation: Existing selected Hero idle, user-driven neighbor transform and shared Capture motion only.
states.accessibility: Selected record is announced once; decorative neighbor peeks are not duplicate focus targets; Pager does not steal vertical scroll.

states.condition: Refresh is pending or fails while a valid Normal Home snapshot exists.
states.layout: Retain prior NH01/NH02 page, stats and selected record ID. No full-screen spinner, page wash, blank content or temporary Empty Home.
states.interaction: Existing navigation and Capture remain available; retry feedback cannot replace the page or card.
states.animation: No refresh animation that changes layout; no replay of card entry.
states.accessibility: Announce refresh/error feedback without moving focus or erasing the retained snapshot.

states.condition: A valid catch photo cannot load, or later becomes available.
states.layout: Preserve Hero outer frame, record, species and available metadata. Replace only the media subview with the registered neutral placeholder; never substitute another catch.
states.interaction: The existing Hero still opens the same FishRecordDetail record ID.
states.animation: No media-recovery entrance or celebration; replace only media content.
states.accessibility: Expose a concise unavailable-photo state, then announce the restored photo if it loads.

states.condition: Home Header identity changes among Guest, registered default, remote load, remote success and remote failure.
states.layout: Keep the Frozen Header position and 92px reference visual circle. Touch target is separate and at least 48dp. NH07 default art is a registered page-state asset, not a new frozen full-page image.
states.interaction: Guest → Login/Register. Signed-in real/default/loading/error → My/Profile. Loading uses NH07 placeholder; failure returns to registered default; sign-out immediately selects Guest.
states.animation: No identity-transition animation or previous-account flash is authorized.
states.accessibility: Expose account action and loading/error state without duplicate focus stops. Keep Guest distinct from signed-in default.
